title: Affine restrictions of raw limit-zero classes eventually vanish
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ a nonempty directed preorder, and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Over}(S)$ a system with affine transitions and qcqs structure maps. Let $c$ be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting and whose structure map is qcqs. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with unital coherent inverse-image maps $\varphi$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $H$, $e_H$ and $h_H$ present their pulled-back coefficient diagram on the limit, with colimit $F$. Fix $p\geq0$, an etale object $U$ over $S$, $i\in I$ and a raw derived-Hom class $z\in P_i(U)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], where $P_i(U)=\operatorname{Hom}((g_i^{-1}\mathbb Z[U])[0],F_i[0][p])$. Let $q:W\to U$ be an arrow of the small etale site with $W$ affine. Write $t\in P_c(U)$ for the explicit raw pullback of $z$ to the limit with its coefficient coprojection [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. Assume the restriction $t|_W$ is zero in the raw group $P_c(W)$, before sheafification. Then there exist $j\in I$ and $f:i\to j$ such that for every etale $V$ over $S$ and every $a:V\to W$, the explicit raw stage pullback of $z|_V$ along $f$ is zero in $P_j(V)$, where this restriction of $z$ is along $a\circ q$. One stage is asserted for restrictions of this fixed affine $W$, with no covering-sieve or sheafification conclusion.

proof.text: Restrict z along q to t. Apply the raw affine comparison theorem on W. It supplies the canonical raw stage and limit maps as natural transformations tau and beta, constrained pointwise to equal the explicit raw pullbacks. Evaluate the naturality square of beta_i at z and use its component equation on U and hz; beta_i(W)(t) is zero.

The cocone-leg equation and additivity give B_i(e_i(t))=0. The proved private additive-group lemma applies injectivity of colimit.desc K B and colimit.ι_desc to identify the colimit images of e_i(t) and zero. Shrink the universe of filtered-colimit preservation by the abelian-group forgetful functor, and apply Mathlib IsColimit.eq_iff' to find j and f:i to j with K(f)(e_i(t))=0. The prescribed stage equation gives e_j(tau_f(W)(t))=0. Apply e_j inverse and use the isomorphism and zero identities; tau_f(W)(t)=0.

For every a:V to W, evaluate the naturality square of tau_f at t. It says tau_f(V)(P_i(a)(t))=P_j(a)(tau_f(W)(t))=0, because restriction is additive. Presheaf functoriality identifies P_i(a)(t) with restriction of z along a composed with q. The component equation for tau_f identifies its value with the explicit raw stage pullback in the conclusion. Thus the same j and f work on all further restrictions.
